author: Janet Winters
text: Bat Pumping & Septic Services have serviced my Septic  pumping for a number of years. Always reliable and friendly! Highly recommend them!! Price was reasonable.

author: Ian Prosser
text: Excellent company to work with! They helped me out in a pinch and were timely, knowledgeable, and kind.

author: steven s
text: Great service. They were prompt and went above and beyond. Very easy to work with. I was impressed by their services.

author: Bergy
text: Being new to septic systems we didn’t know anything about it until we called B.A.T. Septic and pumping. The person who we talked to   ( wife or daughter of  this family owned business ) was knowledgeable and answered questions , and also asked questions to make sure our problem wasn’t an emergency situation. She explained things very well and professionally . Brian showed up on time. He is a very nice man with a lot of knowledge about his work. He explained how it all worked as I was a bit lacking of understanding about septic systems. He was very friendly, patient and helpful. As a former instructor, I noticed that he loved to teach people and share his knowledge. He’s a smart guy and helpful can definitely help you with your questions and concerns about septic issues. Give him a try, you shouldn’t be disappointed.

author: Ryan Welty
text: I had them perform my inspection and couldn’t have been happier with the service. Fast forward several months and I thought I had a broken/cracked pipe. Being somewhat clueless as to the workings of a septic system they could have very easily taken advantage of me with unnecessary maintenance charges, instead through a phone conversation the system was explained to me avoiding a unnecessary charge. I would highly recommend this company and will only be using them for any future needs.
